title: 1.2 Trigonometric Functions: The Unit Circle

icans: I can find the point on the unit circle for a real number t.
I can evaluate the six trigonometric functions using the unit circle.
I can use the period and the even/odd properties to evaluate trigonometric functions.

vocab: the circle x² + y² = 1, with __________ 1 and center at the origin
for the point (x, y) on the unit __________ for t: sin t = y and cos t = x
a function with f(t + c) = f(t) for all t; the ___________ such c is the period

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: For the point (x, y) for t: sin t = y, cos t = _______________, tan t = y/x (x ≠ 0).
Reciprocals: csc t = 1/y, sec t = 1/x, cot t = _______________.
titles: For the point (x, y) for t

blocks.stem: Evaluate all six trigonometric functions at t = π/6.

notes: Period: sin(t + 2πn) = sin t and cos(t + 2πn) = cos t, so sine and cosine have period _______________.
Even and odd: cos(−t) = cos t (even); sin(−t) = _______________ (odd).
